notes: Phase 5: Title Position. Added setPosition(x,y) and resetPosition() to TitleManager, resetTitlePosition() handler, and Reset Position button in the Title sidebar section. Followed strict Red-Green-Refactor TDD cycle: wrote 7 failing tests first (RED), implemented minimal passing code (GREEN), verified all 75 tests pass (REFLECT), reviewed for SOLID compliance (REFACTOR — no changes needed), ran world-review and addressed 2 concerns: (1) added idempotency guard in resetPosition() to skip notify() when already at defaults, (2) added aria-hidden=true to the reset button icon for accessibility. The handler follows the established dual-scheduling pattern (notify + onRenderScheduled) which is consistent across all existing handlers and harmless due to RAF debouncing. Negative coordinate clamping deferred to Phase 6 (interaction layer).
